verdict.rationale: Dover ships some background automations of its own that users turn on once. CRM Campaigns run outreach sequences that keep in touch with candidates, the AI Notetaker joins interviews and fills in feedback forms, and the Calendly integration moves candidates along and sends reminders on its own. There is no documented general automation or workflow builder: the API and webhooks are only building blocks, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a user-configurable trigger/action automation builder, scheduled or recurring custom automations, autonomous agent workflows beyond these fixed features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Use the **Campaigns** tab to build outreach sequences that keep in touch with them, even when they aren't tied to a job.
Dover AI Notetaker joins your interviews, records and transcribes them, and fills in your interview feedback form with notes.
It uses the booking to move the candidate along, prompt interviewers for feedback, and send reminders.
Each applicant gets a score from 0 to 100, so you can review your strongest candidates first.
